groups.name: grails.ai.stub
groups.description: The stubs that stand in for the configured Spring AI provider while the AI testing support is on the classpath.

properties.name: grails.ai.stub.enabled
properties.description: Whether a scripted chat model and a deterministic embedding model stand in for the configured provider's models, which then needs no credentials. Set to false to run tests against the real provider.

properties.name: grails.ai.stub.embeddingDimensions
properties.description: The number of dimensions of the vectors the stub embedding model produces.
